title: Project Manager
description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

**SS Buildtech Ventures Pvt Ltd**, a leading construction and architecture firm based in Delhi, is looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to lead our construction projects. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of managing large-scale building projects, from planning to execution, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and budget. If you are a strategic thinker with exceptional leadership and communication skills, we’d like to meet you.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION**

- Oversee and manage all phases of construction projects from inception to completion.

- Plan project timelines, resources, and budgets while ensuring that project objectives align with company goals.

- Supervise and coordinate between various departments, including engineers, sub-contractors, and suppliers.

- Ensure that project milestones are met on time, within scope, and within budget.

- Manage and resolve any construction issues that arise, and ensure quality control throughout the project lifecycle.

- Monitor and report progress to senior management and other stakeholders.

- Prepare detailed project plans, schedules, and cost estimates.

- Ensure compliance with all building codes, safety regulations, and environmental standards.

- Foster relationships with clients, ensuring clear communication regarding project status and any changes.

title: Project Manager – Admin
description:
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** On-Site  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Department:** Administration & Operations

About the Role

We are looking for an organized, proactive, and responsible **Project Manager – Admin** to manage day-to-day office administration, vendor coordination, employee support, and operational activities. The ideal candidate should be capable of handling multiple responsibilities, ensuring smooth office operations, maintaining proper documentation, and coordinating with internal teams and external vendors.

The candidate should have strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

Key Responsibilities1. Office Administration

* Manage day-to-day office operations and ensure the office runs smoothly.
* Maintain office cleanliness, discipline, and a professional working environment.
* Manage office supplies, stationery, equipment, and inventory.
* Monitor and arrange maintenance of office equipment, furniture, internet, electricity, and other utilities.
* Coordinate office repairs, housekeeping, security, and facility management.
* Ensure office resources are used efficiently and cost-effectively.
* Maintain records of office assets, equipment, and company property.

2. Vendor & Supplier Management

* Identify, onboard, and coordinate with vendors and service providers.
* Manage vendors for housekeeping, internet, IT support, stationery, office maintenance, and other business requirements.
* Request quotations, compare prices, negotiate costs, and ensure timely delivery of services.
* Track vendor payments, invoices, contracts, and service agreements.
* Monitor vendor performance and resolve service-related issues.
* Maintain an updated vendor database and ensure quality service at reasonable costs.

3. Employee & Team Coordination

* Assist with employee onboarding, joining formalities, and exit procedures.
* Coordinate attendance, leave records, employee documentation, and general administrative requirements.
* Support HR in scheduling interviews, maintaining employee records, and coordinating internal activities.
* Communicate company policies, office guidelines, and administrative updates.
* Coordinate with team members to resolve day-to-day workplace issues.
* Help organize employee meetings, training sessions, celebrations, and other office events.

4. Administrative Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain office files, records, bills, invoices, purchase orders, and other documents.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly administrative reports.
* Track office expenses, petty cash, reimbursements, and operational costs.
* Maintain records of vendor payments and coordinate with the accounts team.
* Ensure documents are properly organized, updated, and accessible when required.
* Assist management with administrative reports, data entry, and other documentation.

5. Purchase & Inventory Management

* Monitor stock levels of stationery, pantry supplies, office equipment, and other essentials.
* Raise purchase requests and coordinate procurement activities.
* Maintain inventory records and track the issuance of office assets.
* Ensure timely replenishment of essential supplies.
* Verify deliveries against purchase orders and invoices.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary expenses and improve purchasing efficiency.

6. Travel, Meetings & Event Coordination

* Arrange business travel, hotel bookings, transportation, and other travel requirements.
* Coordinate meeting schedules, conference rooms, and visitor appointments.
* Manage incoming calls, emails, courier services, and visitor coordination as required.
* Organize company meetings, internal events, and employee engagement activities.
* Ensure all logistical requirements are arranged in advance.

7. Operations & Management Support

* Coordinate administrative tasks and operational projects assigned by management.
* Track pending tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups with relevant stakeholders.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend improvements in office processes.
* Ensure administrative activities are completed within the defined timelines and budgets.
* Support management with special projects, reporting, and general operational requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of company information, employee records, and business documents.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–3 years of experience in office administration, operations, facilities management, or a similar role.
* Graduate in any discipline; relevant administrative experience is preferred.
* Strong organizational, coordination, and multitasking abilities.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and email communication.
* Experience in vendor management, purchase coordination, and expense tracking.
* Ability to maintain records, prepare reports, and follow up on pending tasks.
* Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
* A proactive, disciplined, and detail-oriented approach.

Preferred Qualities

* Previous experience managing complete office administration independently.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple vendors and internal departments.
* Strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.
* Cost-conscious mindset with a focus on efficiency.
* Professional attitude, accountability, and a solutions-oriented approach.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Smooth and uninterrupted day-to-day office operations.
* Timely completion of administrative tasks and management requests.
* Effective vendor coordination and service quality.
* Proper maintenance of office records, inventory, and assets.
* Timely processing and tracking of bills, invoices, and expenses.
* Efficient management of office costs and procurement.
* Employee satisfaction with administrative support.
* Timely submission of administrative reports.

What We Are Looking For

We need someone who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions, can manage multiple administrative responsibilities independently, and ensures that every aspect of office operations is handled efficiently. The ideal candidate will act as the central point of coordination for office administration, vendors, employees, and management.

**Work Location:** On-site  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

### **Job description**

**TERMS OF REFERENCE FOR PROJECT MANAGER (INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT)**

  

**TERMS OF REFERENCE**

  

**Hiring Office**

UNFPA India Country Office

  

**Organization Mission and Objectives**

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.

UNFPA’s Strategic Plan 2026–2029 is anchored in the ICPD vision and focuses on four interconnected outcomes: ending unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and enabling countries to anticipate and respond to demographic change through evidence- and rights-based policies.

UNFPA has been a longstanding partner of the Government of India since 1974. It is currently implementing its 10th Country Programme. The Country Programme leverages large-scale government initiatives to strengthen reproductive health outcomes, advance quality of care and reproductive rights.

  

**Purpose of consultancy**

The Project Manager will provide management and coordination support for implementation of the donor-supported family planning projects.

The position will facilitate coordination among UNFPA Country Office and State Offices, Government counterparts, implementing partners, technical agencies and other stakeholders. The Project Manager will support planning, implementation, monitoring, budget tracking, reporting, field coordination and documentation of projects’ results and learning.

The position will also support the translation of project evidence into programme learning, policy dialogue and knowledge products.

  

**Scope of work**

  

***(Description of services, activities, or outputs)***

**(a) Project Planning & Coordination**

* Coordinate the development and implementation of annual, quarterly and monthly project workplans.
* Coordinate with UNFPA State Offices and partners to ensure timely and effective implementation of planned activities.
* Support the implementation of project interventions across identified project geographies.
* Monitor project deliverables, milestones, timelines and key indicators to track progress against agreed plans.
* Identify implementation bottlenecks and facilitate timely follow-up and resolution in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate periodic project review meetings with relevant UNFPA teams, government counterparts and implementing partners.
* Undertake field visits to monitor programme implementation, strengthen coordination and facilitate follow-up on agreed actions.

**(b) Stakeholder Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate with Government departments, State Health Missions, UNFPA State Offices and implementing partners.
* Support coordination with technical and research agencies involved in project implementation.
* Prepare briefing notes, presentations and activity updates for internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate communication and follow-up between the Country Office, State Offices and implementing partners.
* Support government-led review and decision-making processes related to project implementation

**(c) Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting**

* Maintain an updated project monitoring and results tracker.
* Track progress against project indicators, milestones and targets.
* Support collection, compilation and review of programme data from State Offices and implementing partners.
* Monitor project expenditure and support alignment of implementation with approved budgets and workplans.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, annual and donor reports.

**(d) Evidence, Learning and Knowledge Management**

* Document implementation experiences, lessons learned, good practices and evidence from project geographies.
* Support development of learning briefs, case studies and other knowledge products.
* Synthesize evidence and recommendations to inform programme reviews, policy dialogue and scale-up within government systems.

**(e) Strategic Communication and Advocacy**

* Develop project briefs, presentations, infographics and other technical and communication materials.
* Support dissemination of key project results, evidence and learning.
* Prepare briefing materials for government, donor and partner engagements.

**(f) Other Responsibilities**

* Carry out any other duties as may be requested by the supervisor and UNFPA leadership.

  

**Duration and working schedule**

11 Months

(Full Time)

  

**Place where services are to be delivered**

New Delhi

**Deliverable**

**Description**

First week of each quarter

**Monitoring and progress control, including reporting requirements, periodicity format and deadline**

The Project Manager’s performance will be monitored by the reporting manager through regular performance reviews, monthly progress updates and assessment of achievement against agreed workplans, deliverables and project milestones.

The Project Manager will maintain appropriate documentation of activities, outputs, expenditure, risks, challenges and follow-up actions.

  

**Supervisory arrangements**

The Project Manager will report to the SRH Specialist, UNFPA India Country Office, with technical guidance from the Family Planning focal point.

The position will work closely with UNFPA State Offices, relevant technical units, Government counterparts and implementing partners.

  

**Expected travel**

**Knowledge and Experience:**

**Technical Competencies:**

title: Placement Manager – DDU-GKY & Skill Development Projects
description:
Job Title: Placement Manager – DDU-GKY & Skill Development Projects

**Job Location:** Moti Nagar Delhi  
**Department:** Placement & Business Development  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–7 Years in Placement / Skill Development / DDU-GKY / Government Skill Projects

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Placement Manager** to manage placement activities for candidates trained under **DDU-GKY 2.0 and various Skill Development Programs**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with employers, identifying suitable job opportunities, organizing recruitment drives and interviews, and ensuring successful placement of trained candidates in relevant industries and job roles.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the **skill development and placement ecosystem**, excellent employer networking skills, and a proven ability to achieve placement targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end placement activities for candidates trained under **DDU-GKY 2.0 and Skill Development Projects**.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with companies, employers, HR departments, recruiters and industry partners.
* Identify suitable employment opportunities based on candidates' **skills, qualifications, training and job profiles**.
* Generate new employer tie-ups and placement opportunities across relevant industries.
* Collect and understand employer manpower requirements and coordinate recruitment accordingly.
* Organize **job fairs, recruitment drives, walk-in interviews, campus interviews and employer selection processes**.
* Coordinate candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling, documentation and joining formalities.
* Ensure maximum conversion of trained candidates into **successful placements and joining**.
* Maintain regular communication with placed candidates and employers for joining and retention tracking.
* Track placement data, joining status, salary details, employer details and candidate retention.
* Prepare MIS reports, placement reports and project-related documentation within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with Training Centre, Mobilization, MIS and Project teams to achieve overall project placement targets.
* Ensure placement activities are aligned with **DDU-GKY and applicable Skill Development Project guidelines/SOPs**.
* Conduct regular market research to identify new employment sectors, job roles and salary opportunities.
* Build a strong employer database and continuously expand the placement network.
* Support the organization in achieving project-wise placement, joining and retention targets.
* Handle employer and candidate grievances related to the placement process.

Required Skills

* Strong **Employer Relationship Management** skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Strong networking and business development abilities.
* Good knowledge of **placement processes and recruitment practices**.
* Understanding of **DDU-GKY / Skill Development / Government-funded skilling projects**.
* Ability to generate new placement opportunities and employer tie-ups.
* Strong follow-up and target-oriented approach.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Email and MIS reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and placement targets simultaneously.
* Strong team management and coordination skills.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* DDU-GKY / DDU-GKY 2.0 Projects
* Skill Development Projects
* Government Skill Development Programs
* Placement-linked training projects
* Training & Placement organizations
* NSDC / State Skill Mission / PMKVY-related projects
* Recruitment / Staffing / Manpower Industry
* Corporate HR / Employer Relations
* Job Fairs and Campus Recruitment

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of employer tie-ups generated
* Number of job opportunities generated
* Candidate interview and selection ratio
* Placement and joining percentage
* Average salary offered to candidates
* Candidate retention/continuation after joining
* Employer satisfaction
* Timely and accurate MIS/project reporting
* Achievement of project-wise placement targets

Education

**Bachelor's Degree** in any discipline is required.

MBA/PGDM in HR, Marketing, Business Development or a related field will be an added advantage.

Salary

**₹25,000 – ₹50,000 per month**, depending on experience, skills and project requirements.

**Performance-based incentives** may be provided for achieving placement and employer engagement targets.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a **target-oriented, proactive and well-connected placement professional** who can independently develop employer networks and convert trained candidates into meaningful employment opportunities.

Candidates with strong experience in **DDU-GKY, Skill Development Projects, Placement Management and Employer Tie-ups** will be given preference.

**Apply Now** if you have the experience and skills to build strong industry connections and successfully place trained candidates in suitable employment opportunities.

* **Coordination \& Communication** : Act as the primary point of contact for customers and other teams; lead project meetings and manage team member expectations.

* **Risk \& Issue Management** : Identify risks early, implement mitigation strategies, and resolve issues promptly.
* **Reporting** : Provide regular status updates, financial forecasts, and documentation for partners.

* Experience in project management in industrial automation or related sectors.
* Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with Rockwell Automation products and tools like Microsoft Project.
* Inspire, guide, and develop teams to achieve organisational goals.
* Plan and prioritisation capabilities to ensure efficient workflow and resource management.
* Foster collaboration and understanding across all levels.
* Project Management: experience to manage multiple projects within a matrix environment, ensuring delivery and quality outcomes.

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have:**

* Total experience 10\+ years with 2\+ years in project management in industrial automation or related sectors.
* Experience in project management for process automation
* Partner with multiple team members and influence project decisions, teamwork, customer service

**What We Offer:**

... and other local benefits!

AI Program Strategy \& Solutioning

title: Project Engineer-Operations
description:
**Why This Role Exists**
The Project Engineer – Operations role exists to strengthen how construction projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered by ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows seamlessly across teams. This role transforms design data, BIM models, and project documentation into clear guidance that supports predictable outcomes, reduces risk, and improves decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle.


By proactively identifying issues, improving constructability, and supporting disciplined workflows, the Project Engineer enables project teams to move from reactive problem\-solving to confident execution.

**Responsibility and Focus Areas:**
-----------------------------------

**Document \& Models Management** – Understand, analyze, and manage the versions of construction documents \& models on cloud platform ensuring the latest and greatest information is available to field team. The process can involve various Project Management Platforms like ACC Build, Procore, Bluebeam etc.

**RFI Management** – Early identification of the potential RFI’s (Request for Information) on a project through Drawings \& Model based review and coordination, also understanding the raised RFI to identify appropriate details and portions of drawings impacted by RFI and link the same on the drawings for every stakeholder’s awareness.

**Submittal Management** – Understanding the project specifications and interpreting it to create submittal log. Assist the project team in creating, tracking, and managing the submittal on Project Management Platforms

**Change Management** – Through the updated Drawings and Models, assisting the project in tracking and reflecting the cost changes (due to changes in Drawings, RFI or any other factor) on the Project Management Platforms. Also, generating a scope change report by comparing the revised drawings against the current set of drawings, to help the project teams in validating cost changes.

**Construction Document \& Design Review** – Review various construction documents like Design Drawings, Construction Drawings, Shop Drawings, Submittals and RFIs in the preconstruction phase to identify inconsistencies, incomplete information, and constructability issues.

**Model Based Coordination** – Leveraging BIM, identify and resolve spatial and temporal conflicts between trades virtually thereby preempting them in the field which could be costly and can derail the project schedule. Identify data inconsistencies using Navisworks.

**Quality check** models for completeness, accuracy and constructability based on design drawings and construction know\-how. Use automation wherever possible.


Use **Data Visualization** means to track metrics, indicators for project progress, and quality.

**Process Improvement \& Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows and tools.
* Partner with innovation teams on automation and AI initiatives.
* Document lessons learned and best practices.

**A day in this role**


The day begins with reviewing priorities, open items, and any risks that need attention. You look at model updates, documents, and change requests to ensure the information going to the team is accurate and current. Short conversations with project managers, engineers, and field teams help align what needs to move first. You support client check ins by preparing updates or clarifying next steps. You guide junior team members on technical questions or workflow challenges. You spend time coordinating with cross functional groups so information flows without gaps. You also explore improvements in the way work is done by trying new tools or refining steps that can reduce rework. Before wrapping up, you capture key learnings, update trackers, and prepare for what the next day will require.

**What You Should Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
* 2\-5 years of experience in construction operations and/or BIM
* Strong understanding of construction lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of building systems and proficiency with tools such as Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, BIM 360 or ACC, and Procore.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills.
